$schema_comment: vb6-archaeology kit configuration. Agents: Read AGENTS.md then docs/ai-onboarding.md.

notes.protected: Directories listed in protected_source_dirs are read-only. Hooks deny Write/StrReplace/Delete into them. Exception: python tools/make_fixture.py may regenerate source/mini_vbp/. Rename via this list if your immutable tree is not called source/.
notes.geometry_hints: Optional map of FormName → {left,top,width,height} twips used when evaluating parent-relative runtime expressions.
notes.deep_read_name_map: Optional map of VB_Name → output key for frm_deep_read_all.py (e.g. {"MDIForm1": "mdi"}). Empty = always lowercase VB_Name.
notes.layout_sub_scores: Optional map of lowercase Sub name → int score for runtime_layout open-path preference. Kit default is form_load/mdiform_load only. Put app-specific openers (e.g. stet_click) in the consumer config — do not upstream them into the kit.
notes.consumer: When adopting this kit, set protected_source_dirs to your immutable VB6 tree name(s). Use requires LICENSE permission.
